text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I've lost again and again...
But every single time, it just makes me feel more frustrated...!
And makes me think, "Next time for sure...!"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
The hero I looked up to always got back up,
no matter how many times they were knocked down...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: That's why I've decided to keep looking forward too...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, I'm sorry... acting all high and mighty...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Even on a vast adventure... I am not alone...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Please continue to guide and support me...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: "...You're right. I'll push through this tough training and build an unshakeable mindset too!"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I... will see this through to the end!
